fee_type: Duplex unit: Water System Development Fee, one 5/8 or 3/4-inch meter per dwelling unit
source_section: WSFCU User Rate & Fee Manual FY 2026-27, Water System Development Fees by meter size; Utility rules Part A Art. I Sec. 14(A) (separate meters) and Sec. 42(B)
source_quote: Each water Customer shall be required to have a separate meter; provided, that one (1) meter may be used for several premises, apartments, and blocks of stores where they are the property of the same Owner.
notes: Winston-Salem; Plex utility rule 2026-11-09 (manual fee lookups P1): WSFCU charges the SDF per new connection by meter size ('The fee will be determined by meter size', Sec. 42(B); sewer Sec. 128(b)); no per-dwelling-unit or multifamily rate. Each customer must have its own meter, but one owner may serve several apartments through one meter, so a rental plex may use a master meter. Typical: one 5/8 or 3/4-inch meter per unit (the rule's default; required if units are sold separately) = house amount per unit. Low: one 5/8-3/4-inch master meter for the building ($408.00/unit); high: one 1-inch master meter ($1,020.00/unit). Master-meter size is not set by the code (plumbing sizing); a fourplex on one 3/4-inch meter would be $204.00/unit. 2 units of about 1,000 sq ft.
